codeReview.summary: The commit correctly adds the required @enbox/agent patch changeset, but the feature was marked successful despite failing its own full-suite flake-guard acceptance criteria.

issues.description: The handoff reports success (`successState: success`) even though it also records the full-suite command as non-zero (`exitCode: 1`, line 27) and includes a real `# Unhandled error between tests` occurrence (line 33). This contradicts the feature acceptance requirements for full-suite `0 fail` and zero forbidden strings (`features.json` lines 172 and 181), so this feature should not be accepted as complete.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission acceptance rules are inconsistent across shared state, creating ambiguous pass/fail handling for this feature.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: features.json:172 requires not completing the feature if any test fails or forbidden string appears; validation-contract.md:115 requires `exits 0 with 0 fail` but then says the assertion fails only if forbidden strings appear; AGENTS.md:101-108 says two full-suite hook-timeout failures are pre-existing and should not be treated as regressions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The agent-fix-worker skill's full-suite step assumes `0 fail` but does not define precedence when AGENTS.md declares known pre-existing full-suite failures.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/agent-fix-worker/SKILL.md:59-63 instructs `bun run test:node` and `tail -5 ... # confirm 0 fail`, while mission AGENTS.md:101-108 explicitly documents known pre-existing full-suite hook-timeout failures.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared testing docs do not call out that forbidden-string grep on full-suite logs can match passing test names, which can create false-positive/ambiguous interpretations.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/user-testing.md:10 and 34 instruct grep-based detection; /tmp/full-suite.log has matching strings in passing test names at lines 204 and 559, plus one real unhandled line at 1748.

summary: Review failed: commit 837ea9d adds the expected changeset file, but the feature was marked successful even though full-suite evidence shows `exitCode: 1`, `2 fail`, and a real `# Unhandled error between tests` occurrence, which does not satisfy the stated flake-guard acceptance criteria.
